##### Capacities:

Enjoy a high-speed gaming experience and work efficiency with the Lexar ® NM760 M.2 2280 PCIe Gen4x4 NVMe SSD. Designed for gamers and professionals with speeds of up to 5300MB/s read and 4500MB/s 1 write, get 9.6x 3 the performance compared to traditional SATA-based SSD. Leverages PCIe Gen 4x4 NVMe1.4 technology standard and backwards compatible with PCIe 3.0.

Enjoy the coolness. With an optional heatsink, you can unleash the outstanding performance and don’t need to worry about sudden performance drops from high temperature.

Built to Last. Unlike traditional hard disk drives, the NM760 SSD has no moving parts, so it’s built to last. On top of that, it’s also shock and vibration resistant 2, making it one robust and reliable SSD.

Widely compatible with various devices. The NM760 is widely compatible with notebooks, PC, PlayStation ® 5 and etc., delivers powerful performance for high-speed storage backup and access to content

Rigorously tested. All Lexar products undergo extensive testing in the Lexar Quality Labs, facilities with thousands of different cameras and digital devices to ensure performance, quality, compatibility, and reliability.

Energy Efficient with 12nm processor. Developed with the 12nm controller, the NM760 SSD consumes less power for longer battery life and better user experience.

• Experience high-speed PCle NMe Gen 4x4 performance: 5300MB/s read 4500MB/s write speed 1 - supports NVMe 1.4, with M.2 2280 form factor 
• Get 9.6x 3 faster than a SATA-based SSD 
• Developed with the 12nm controller for lower power consumption 
• Enjoy the coolness with an optional added heatsink 
• Wide range of compatibility: Compatible with PlayStation ®5, notebooks, and PCs. 
• Shock and vibration resistant with no moving parts 2 
• Five-year limited warranty
